work_description: Addition of new windows, doors and shade canopies. Replace existing siding with stucco on the north elevation and new siding on lvl 2 south elevation. New roof and rework soffit. New exterior lighting, flatwork and landscaping.

Includes reorganization of existing kitchen equipment and addition of new fryer units.  The existing type 1 hood and wrapped ducts will be replaced with Type 1 new equipment. Rooftop equipment will remain existing.

Remove existing roof layers down to metal roof deck.
- Remove existing metal coping cap, drip edge, flashings, and accessories as needed for installation of the new roof.
- Delete unused/obsolete penetration items.
- Install one layer 4.5” (3.5 “ + 1”) iso board over existing roof surface to provide a clean, smooth surface for the new roof.
- Mechanically fasten iso board per manufacturer’s recommendations at a minimum of 5 fasteners per 4x8 sheet using Firestone screws and
plates.
- Fully adhere Firestone White 60 mil TPO roof membrane to entire field of roof per manufacturer guidelines, using all Firestone fasteners and
accessories.
- Fully adhere Firestone White 60 mil TPO on the parapet wall, encapsulating top of parapet wall.
- Install Firestone prefabricated flashings on roof penetrations.
- Replace plumbing vent flashings and heat stacks.
- Set all roof side plumbing and electrical conduit on 1.5 Miro pipe stands. (This is in lieu of 4x4 wood posts that rot over time, compromising the
TPO membrane.)
- Install new pre-finished 24 gauge metal custom fabricated coping cap with continuous cleat on parapet wall located on the west side of the
building.
- Install termination bar along rear elevation to allow proper water flow into gutters.
- Install new gutters & downspouts to rear elevation.
- Provide Firestone Standard 20 Year Materials & Labor Warranty.
- 5 Year Workmanship Warranty provided by D&G Roof Systems, LLC.
Building Permits: The cost of building permits is included in this bid.
- Obtain necessary construction permits from City of Fort Worth.
- Thoroughly clean roof and job site and haul off all construction debris.
